sample_unit: clinical notes (cancer corpus; plus 200 opioid-use notes for cross-disease validation)

links.outcome: NLP SDoH extraction performance across race and gender subgroups
links.effect: Small performance gap (~4%) between males and females, but a large performance gap (>16%) among race groups.
links.quote: There is a small performance gap (∼4%) between Males and Females, but a large performance gap (>16 %) among race groups.

links.outcome: Performance of cancer SDoH model on opioid cohort before and after local fine-tuning
links.effect: Performance dropped when the cancer SDoH model was applied to the opioid cohort; fine-tuning using a smaller opioid SDoH corpus improved performance.
links.quote: The performance dropped when we applied the cancer SDoH model to the opioid cohort; fine-tuning using a smaller opioid SDoH corpus improved the performance.

screen.reason: Evaluates NLP/LLM models (including GatorTron) on extracting social determinants of health and examines demographic bias and cross-domain generalizability, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
